process MGNIFAM_UPDATEFAMILIES {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_high'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/07/07d734ffff975d82e7381943964ea0b875606d69d7f3b3c35d1488833fff960b/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/mgnifam:4.1.0--818ca9d3b99bfbca'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(hmms, stageAs: 'hmm_input/*'), path(fasta_file), path(fasta_index)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/seed_msa/*.sto.gz")                   , emit: seed_msa  , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/full_msa/*.sto.gz")                   , emit: full_msa  , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/hmm/*.hmm.gz")                        , emit: hmm       , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/rf/*.txt")                            , emit: rf        , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_families.tsv")      , emit: tsv       , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_metadata.csv")      , emit: csv       , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/${prefix}_updated.log")               , emit: log       , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_reps.fasta.gz")     , emit: reps_fasta, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_successful.txt")    , emit: successful, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_discarded.csv")     , emit: discarded , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_converged.txt")     , emit: converged , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_delta.csv")         , emit: delta     , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_mgnifam_stats.json"), emit: stats     , optional: true
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('mgnifam'), eval("mgnifam --version 2>&1"), topic: versions, emit: versions_mgnifam

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args  = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix    = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def index = fasta_index ? "--fasta_index \"${fasta_index}\"" : ''
    """
    lib_file=\$(find hmm_input -maxdepth 1 -name '*.hmm.lib*' -print -quit)

    mgnifam update_families \\
        --hmm_input "\${lib_file:-hmm_input}" \\
        --fasta_file "${fasta_file}" \\
        --output_dir "${prefix}" \\
        --cpus ${task.cpus} \\
        --chunk_id "${prefix}" \\
        ${index} \\
        ${args}
    """

    stub:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix   = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    echo $args

    mkdir -p ${prefix}/seed_msa ${prefix}/full_msa ${prefix}/hmm ${prefix}/rf
    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}/seed_msa/1_7.sto.gz
    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}/full_msa/1_7.sto.gz
    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}/hmm/1_7.hmm.gz
    touch ${prefix}/rf/1_7.txt
    touch ${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_families.tsv
    touch ${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_metadata.csv
    touch ${prefix}/${prefix}_updated.log
    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_reps.fasta.gz
    touch ${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_successful.txt
    touch ${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_discarded.csv
    touch ${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_converged.txt
    touch ${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_delta.csv
    touch ${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_mgnifam_stats.json
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/mgnifam/updatefamilies"
description: "Refreshes existing protein family HMM profiles against a new sequence\
  \ database, keeping each family's name stable across releases"
keywords:
- "protein families"
- "family update"
- "database update"
- "hidden markov model"
- "profile hmm"
- "sequence alignment"
- "metagenomics"
- "hmmer"
- "protein sequences"
tools:
- mgnifam:
    description: "Iterative HMM-based protein family generation over large protein\
      \ sequence databases"
    homepage: "https://github.com/vagkaratzas/mgnifam"
    documentation: "https://vagkaratzas.github.io/mgnifam/"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/vagkaratzas/mgnifam"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    args_id: "$args"
    identifier: "biotools:mgnifam"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - hmms:
      type: "file"
      description: "One or more gzipped profile HMM files (e.g. the `hmm` output of\
        \ mgnifam/generatefamilies) or a single gzipped multi-model HMM library, staged\
        \ under `hmm_input/`. Each model is searched against the new database and\
        \ re-emitted under its original name"
      pattern: "*.{hmm,hmm.gz,hmm.lib.gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1370"
  - fasta_file:
      type: "file"
      description: "Uncompressed FASTA file of the new protein sequence database to\
        \ search the stored HMMs against"
      pattern: "*.{fa,fasta,faa}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
  - fasta_index:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional. Easel SSI index of the FASTA file (e.g. from hmmer/eslsfetchindex),\
        \ built when omitted"
      pattern: "*.ssi"
      ontologies: []
output:
  seed_msa:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}/seed_msa/*.sto.gz:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional. Per-family seed multiple sequence alignment in gzipped\
          \ Stockholm format, named by family id (e.g. `1_7.sto.gz`). Not written\
          \ when the tool is run with `--skip_refine`"
        pattern: "*/seed_msa/*.sto.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
  full_msa:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}/full_msa/*.sto.gz:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional. Per-family full multiple sequence alignment against\
          \ the new database, including recruited members, in gzipped Stockholm format,\
          \ named by family id (e.g. `1_7.sto.gz`)"
        pattern: "*/full_msa/*.sto.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
  hmm:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}/hmm/*.hmm.gz:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional. Updated per-family profile HMM model in gzipped HMMER\
          \ format, named by family id (e.g. `1_7.hmm.gz`)"
        pattern: "*/hmm/*.hmm.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
  rf:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}/rf/*.txt:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional. Per-family reference annotation (RF) line, marking\
          \ match-state columns of the seed alignment, named by family id (e.g. `1_7.txt`).\
          \ Not written when the tool is run with `--skip_refine`"
        pattern: "*/rf/*.txt"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3671"
  tsv:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_families.tsv:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional. Roster of the updated protein families"
        pattern: "*/*_updated_families.tsv"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  csv:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_metadata.csv:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional. Metadata describing the updated protein families"
        pattern: "*/*_updated_metadata.csv"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3752"
  log:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}/${prefix}_updated.log:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional. Diagnostic log of the family update run"
        pattern: "*/*_updated.log"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3671"
  reps_fasta:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_reps.fasta.gz:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional. Representative sequences of the updated families in\
          \ gzipped FASTA format"
        pattern: "*/*_updated_reps.fasta.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
  successful:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_successful.txt:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional. List of families that were successfully updated"
        pattern: "*/*_updated_successful.txt"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3671"
  discarded:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_discarded.csv:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional. Families discarded during the update, with reasons"
        pattern: "*/*_updated_discarded.csv"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3752"
  converged:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_converged.txt:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional. List of families that converged during the update"
        pattern: "*/*_updated_converged.txt"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3671"
  delta:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_delta.csv:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional. One row per input family describing the change against\
          \ the new database. Columns `family_id` (the model name, e.g. `1_7`, not\
          \ a rank), `model_length_before`, `model_length_after`, `round1_recruits`,\
          \ `full_msa_size`, `retention`, `rounds_run`, `converged` (empty under `--skip_refine`),\
          \ `outcome`"
        pattern: "*/*_updated_delta.csv"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3752"
  stats:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}/${prefix}_updated_mgnifam_stats.json:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional. MultiQC-ready summary of the run - family counts,\
          \ discard reasons, and histograms of seed and full MSA size, model length\
          \ and representative length, plus model length change, rounds run and retention.\
          \ Written only after a completed run"
        pattern: "*/*_updated_mgnifam_stats.json"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3464"
  versions_mgnifam:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - mgnifam:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - mgnifam --version 2>&1:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - mgnifam:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - mgnifam --version 2>&1:
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@vagkaratzas"
maintainers:
- "@vagkaratzas"
containers:
  docker:
    linux/arm64:
      name: "community.wave.seqera.io/library/mgnifam:4.1.0--f1cee804024a318d"
      build_id: "bd-f1cee804024a318d_1"
      scan_id: "sc-34dc30352b7bd368_1"
    linux/amd64:
      name: "community.wave.seqera.io/library/mgnifam:4.1.0--818ca9d3b99bfbca"
      build_id: "bd-818ca9d3b99bfbca_1"

    linux/arm64:
